relations.description: ATTACH ACCEPT message contains EMM cause IE.
EMM cause value #2, #16, #18 trigger stopping timer T3410.
EMM cause value #2 and #18 lead to entering EMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE state.
EMM cause value #2, #16, #18 lead to entering MM IDLE state.
EMM cause value #2 establishes update status U3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED.
EMM cause value #18 establishes update status U2 NOT UPDATED.
When tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, timer T3411 is started.
When tracking area updating attempt counter equals 5, timer T3402 is started.
Timer T3411 expiration triggers combined tracking area updating procedure in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state.
Timer T3402 expiration triggers combined tracking area updating procedure in EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM state.
EMM cause values #16 and #18 establish EPS update status EU1 UPDATED.
